close_reason: Filed as standalone issue JMAP-yecd.2; MemoryBackend Mutex prevents the race in tests; production backends must implement idempotent create
description: vacation.rs handle_vacation_set has a documented concurrency note (line ~183): two concurrent requests that both hit the NotFound branch both call create_object for the singleton. The code says 'Backends that receive concurrent requests MUST make create_object idempotent for the singleton key via a unique constraint or compare-and-swap.' This pushes a correctness requirement onto every backend implementor without encoding it in the trait or tests. Maintenance consequence: a new backend that doesn't read the comment will pass the current test suite (MemoryBackend holds a Mutex so the race never fires there) and only surface data corruption under concurrent load in production.
title: VacationResponse upsert has documented TOCTOU race with no mitigation
